xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4523: God View river: shelf and doldrums labels overprint, merged issues stick on the shelf, PLAN/REVIEW counters count stopped agents

plan.title: God View river: shelf and doldrums labels overprint, merged issues stick on the shelf, PLAN/REVIEW counters count stopped agents
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The God View river misdraws three things. (1) The shelf band [H-108,H-74] and the doldrums band [H-76,H-12] overlap in RiverCanvas.tsx canvasLayout; stale-orb labels, the doldrums header and shelf reasons land on one ~25 px strip, and shelf reasons rise above riverBottom; nothing measures text and nothing caps shelf orbs. model.ts computeLayout is a second, dead layout that only the tests use. (2) classifyOrb returns 'shelf' for any paused orb first, so merged issues whose agents carry merge-agent.ts's close-out pause ('awaiting close-out (verify on main)') sit on the shelf and never take the MERGE exit (which runs only for state 'active'); bypassing only the shelf branch would drop them into the Doldrums via the stale branch. (3) orbStage in useConfluenceData.ts counts stopped plan/review/test agents, so a finished planner makes a working issue count as PLAN.
narratives.Proposal: Frontend-only fix, per the PRD at .pan/drafts/PAN-4523.md. W1 moves the live layout into model.ts computeLayout with disjoint shelf/doldrums bands (gap 10 px) and fixed text baselines per band row, deletes canvasLayout, and rewires positionOrb and drawZones. W2 adds pure fitText/shelfSlotWidth/staleSlotWidth helpers and truncates shelf labels, shelf reasons and stale labels with ctx.measureText. W3 caps shelf orbs at 8 (longest-idle first). W4 adds CLOSE_OUT_PAUSE_REASON and a classifyOrb branch that returns 'active' for a merged issue whose only pauses are the close-out pause. W5 requires activeStatus() on the plan/review/test stage overrides. W6 renames the shelf header to '⏸ SHELF — paused / parked / yielded' and updates the field guide. W7 updates docs/GOD-VIEW.md. W8 adds an isolated Playwright spec that seeds five shelf and five stale orbs and commits a screenshot.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing src/lib/cloister/merge-agent.ts, the close-out reason string, the stall resolver, /api/parked, or any server code
- Adding a shelf census (shelfTotal) to the shelf header
- Collision culling for active-river orb labels, tickers, or convoy satellites
- Changing the stale threshold, frost timings, or merge-dwell timing
- Moving the close-out reason into @overdeck/contracts as a shared constant
- Raising scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt for any file

autoDecisions.summary: Keep one layout function: replace model.ts computeLayout's body with the live band layout and delete RiverCanvas.tsx canvasLayout (rather than deleting computeLayout).
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's band-disjointness AC needs a testable exported layout; canvasLayout is private. Deleting the duplicate satisfies 'delete the unused computeLayout' while making the tested function the drawn one.

autoDecisions.summary: Band geometry: doldrums [H-128,H-32] (96 px) above a 32 px HUD gutter, shelf [H-208,H-138] (70 px), gap 10 px, riverBottom H-220; text baselines fixed per band row; shelf reason drawn below the orb; stale labels above upper-row orbs and below lower-row orbs.
autoDecisions.rationale: Every text row must sit inside its band regardless of orb wobble; fixed baselines make FR-2 a pure, testable property. River still spans 312 px at H=600. The 32 px gutter keeps the bottom HUD (.confluence-tag/.confluence-hint at bottom: 8px) off the lower label row (plan critique round 1).

autoDecisions.summary: Truncate with measured text via a pure fitText(text, maxWidth, measure) helper instead of moving reasons to the tooltip only.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue lists truncation first; the hover tooltip already shows the full yield reason; the vitest canvas stub returns width 0, so an injected measure is the only way to unit-test the width property.

autoDecisions.summary: Widen the shelf spread from width*0.5 to width*0.7.
autoDecisions.rationale: The header now has its own row, so the right half is free; wider spacing gives each reason ~116 px instead of ~79 px at 8 orbs and 1280 px.

autoDecisions.summary: SHELF_ORB_LIMIT = 8, keep the largest idleMin first; no shelf census in the header.
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors STALE_ORB_LIMIT's oldest-first rule; 8 leaves room for the 5-orb screenshot AC; no pause timestamp exists on the orb; a census needs a new prop and is out of scope.

autoDecisions.summary: classifyOrb returns 'active' (not merely 'not shelf') for derivedState 'merged' when not scheduler-yielded and either unpaused or paused only with CLOSE_OUT_PAUSE_REASON.
autoDecisions.rationale: Close-out-paused agents go idle, so the stale branch would catch the orb and drop it into the Doldrums; only 'active' triggers the MERGE exit. Exact-reason match keeps operator holds on merged issues shelved.

autoDecisions.summary: Duplicate the close-out reason as a frontend constant CLOSE_OUT_PAUSE_REASON in model.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: The frontend cannot import src/lib and the issue forbids changing merge-agent.ts; the drift risk is recorded as a hazard.

autoDecisions.summary: Apply the live-agent guard to line 310 (test → TEST) as well as lines 311-312.
autoDecisions.rationale: Same defect in the same function; the code comment already says the review lane splits only when a test agent is live.

autoDecisions.summary: Shelf and stale orbs that leave the cast are dropped from the canvas at once (evictionFor returns 'drop') instead of fading for one second.
autoDecisions.rationale: The fade let a replaced shelf orb draw a ninth orb for a second, breaking the cap on screen (plan critique round 1). Active orbs keep their fade; MERGE orbs keep their exit.

autoDecisions.summary: The bottom tag text changes from 'shelf = yielded' to 'shelf = paused / yielded'.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the HUD legend consistent with the renamed shelf header.

Truncate shelf labels, shelf reasons and stale labels to their slot width with measured text

narrative.Action: PRD work item W2 and decision D4. Add to model.ts: SLOT_MARGIN = 12; fitText(text, maxWidth, measure) returning text unchanged when it fits, else the longest prefix p with measure(p + '…') <= maxWidth as p + '…', else ''; shelfSlotWidth(layout, count) = (count <= 1 ? width*0.7 : width*0.7/(count-1)) - SLOT_MARGIN; staleSlotWidth(layout, count) = 2*(width*0.72 - padX)/max(1,count) - SLOT_MARGIN, where width = colW*STAGES.length + padX*2. In RiverCanvas drawOrbs, count shelf and stale orbs once per frame, set the draw font first, then draw fitText(..., slot, (v) => fx.measureText(v).width) for the shelf id label, the shelf reason (remove the length > 58 slice at line 574), and the stale label. Write the new fit-text.test.ts with a fake measure of 6 px per character.
